scope: Static scorer audit only; no new RL environment, action head or checkpoint

resource_rules.hybrid_access: 10MHz nominal/9MHz occupied; 50% of legacy27dBm Access power
resource_rules.hybrid_backhaul: 50MHz nominal/45MHz occupied receive AND forward, nested inside existing shared100/90MHz; 50% of legacy20dBm UAV BH TX power
resource_rules.source_power: Each edge uses minimum endpoint bandwidth, full source role-limited RF power on that negotiated band; BS stays20dBm
resource_rules.frequency_plan: Hybrid occupies lower half of existing per-color Access band and lower half of shared BH band; overlapping PSD integrated in separate slices
resource_rules.duplex: Each BH endpoint, including BS, at most one RX or TX edge at a time. Access/BH have independent RF chains as assumed by legacy scorer
resource_rules.routing: Existing isolated-bottleneck route heuristic; pure Access direct or via one Relay/Hybrid. Hybrid own service and forwarding ingress require direct BS; no Hybrid chains
resource_rules.flow: Hybrid ingress equals own delivered traffic plus forwarding; aggregate per-edge flows limited by one global half-duplex schedule
resource_rules.power: Hybrid Access+BH transmit bound is0.5*P_A+0.5*P_R, no role receives two full RF power budgets
resource_rules.energy: Not changed or validated by static scorer. Future normalized radio drain candidate0.5*Access+0.5*Relay, no hardware/battery benefit claim

audit.selection: Snapshot mean TCF criteria per frame, exact role enumeration only over active UAVs; secondary best-throughput results kept separate
audit.limitations: Development frames on old-policy trajectories (corpus identified in receipt); snapshot role search is privileged, correlated, and not an executable RL policy, optimized trajectory or independent benchmark
